user_request: Use an established public validated locomotion reward, replacing bespoke rewards; SuperMimic remains training algorithm. Other-dog motion references permitted but not used.

upstream.hardware_validation_scope: WTW upstream Go1 only. This B2/SuperMimic adaptation is experimental, not hardware validated.
upstream.composition: WTW public additive compute_reward branch; both only_positive flags false

algorithm.training: SuperMimic learned dynamics + 32-step BPTT actor update + critic
algorithm.actor: continue our WTW it80000; formal may continue verified repair pilot
algorithm.critic: reset if reward changes; inherit only same-reward repair continuation

morphology: B2 .032 m foot radius instead of .02 m
B2 joint limits, PD control, action scales and solver geometry
adaptations.stop_command: freeze each raw foot phase at duration/2, so its warped public clock is .25 and contact target is near 1
adaptations.actor_input: 420 proprioceptive history + velocity command3 + internally generated gait clock4
adaptations.world_model_aux: real applied torques, real solver foot forces, thigh/calf collision flags; supervised prediction, no extra locomotion penalties
retained: standard standing and zero velocity resets
original physical termination and six-hour budget protection

reward_config_changes.combination: Pinned WTW legged_robot.py compute_reward, both only_positive flags False: additive, without clipping or exponential gating
reward_config_changes.torque_scaling: Public raw squared torque formula evaluated at equal fraction of Go1/B2 effort limits
reward_config_changes.force_scaling: Public force exponential kernel at equal force/body-weight ratio
reward_config_changes.acceptance: Unchanged; these are disclosed training adaptations, not an unchanged validated B2 recipe

acceptance.success: two full evaluations, every core case >=95% and nominal pass

selection.initialization: saved as initial_eval, excluded from trained best
selection.trained_best: lexicographic strict passes, gait passes, legacy passes, completions, lower airborne, lower velocity error
selection.accepted: only an all-core-95 physical pass; task success still requires two consecutive passes
selection.protection: stop after 30 minutes without best-key improvement once >=20000 repair iterations; preserve six-hour maximum
